notes: Fixture palette — invented, so nothing here derives from third-party art. 'ink_rgb' is not part of the ElevationLUT schema; make_source.py reads it to paint the label/graticule strokes. It is deliberately close to the 'mountain' swatch (distance 44) and dark (luminance 65), which is exactly the relationship the real Terraqueous label red has to the real >7000 m swatch — so the fixture reproduces the failure mode rather than a caricature of it.
